name: check_inputs
description: Diff inputs/ against inputs.json (size and sha256). The manifest is validated whole first: a malformed entry, a duplicate path, a regular file with no size or no sha256 (a size-only check is not a verification) are reported, never skipped. A file that cannot be opened is unreadable, one not reached before the time budget is not_checked, and neither passes. Links are checked by their target and pipes, sockets and devices by their kind. Every file's result is written, as it is checked, to a receipts file of its own for this run. A directory under inputs/ that cannot be listed is unreadable. Returns modified, missing, added and checked as before, plus malformed, duplicates, digest_missing, unreadable, not_checked and bytes_hashed. A pass means agreement with the baseline: it does not show the evidence is authentic or complete. This is the pack tool's receipt; the harness's own inputs_check event is written by the harness at completion, not by this tool. In a job it reads the copy of the run's inputs.json the job service gives a job that sees all of inputs/ (SWARM_INPUTS_MANIFEST); a job with a narrower scope, or a manifest past the job service's size limit, gets none, and the tool says so. Each list in the answer holds at most 200 paths, with the count of all of them (modified_total, missing_total and added_total always; the other lists carry <name>_total when they are cut), and the receipts file holds a row for every one, the files added under inputs/ and the manifest's malformed and duplicate entries included. The walk over inputs/ for added files reads the clock for every entry; one the budget stops is a not_checked entry that says where. status is complete when every file was checked and the walk finished, whatever it showed; partial when a file is not_checked, unreadable, malformed or digest_missing; failed when the tool refused and checked nothing; ok is the agreement verdict and status_basis says which. SIGTERM, SIGINT and SIGHUP end it with one JSON answer (partial, with interrupted true and the signal, and what was done), exit 128 plus the signal, and the removal of the hidden file it was writing.

max_seconds.description: Time budget in seconds for reading the manifest and hashing (default 1500, at most 1700). Hashing runs to max_seconds; the walk over inputs/ for added files then gets a fifth of it more (at least 1 and at most 60 seconds), so the whole run takes at most max_seconds plus that, inside the tool's own 1800 second limit; files and directories not reached are reported as not_checked, the status is partial and the run fails
